statusNote: Proposed before any holdout execution. Maintainers may change a value only before the lock; the lock records this file's digest. Derivations are in docs/quality/doctor-release-gates.md.

confidence.method: exact one-sided binomial (Clopper-Pearson) bound; a gate is met only when the bound, not the point estimate, clears the limit

defectPrecision.population: all emitted warning and error findings, matched or audited

cueFactualAccuracy.population: emitted info findings, matched or audited

runtime.baseline: the previously published candidate replayed on the same machine, interleaved with the locked candidate

decision.go: Every coverage requirement for every category the release documentation describes as accurate is met, every accuracy gate passes, and every security and runtime gate passes.
decision.scopedGo: A category below its coverage minimum is unvalidated. Release is allowed only if the documentation says so for that category and makes no accuracy claim for it.
decision.noGo: Any failed accuracy gate in a validated category, or any non-zero security gate.
